verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since e-FRRO is an online government e-service with a sign-in path, but the evidence never describes how sign-in works. The probes show only that the root URL returns a script-only application shell and that the long-published entry URL now returns 404. Nothing documents whether sign-in uses remotely completable credential MFA rather than biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN verification.
